outcome: Pregnancy complications (preeclampsia, cesarean section, SGA, macrosomia, postpartum hemorrhage)
finding: Paternal obesity was associated with increased fetal growth parameters, placental weight, and risk of pregnancy complications, including preeclampsia, cesarean section, small for gestational age (SGA), macrosomia, and postpartum hemorrhage.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight measured, showed an increasing trend with higher paternal BMI
